svg.title: Masking Python -12 with 0xFFFFFFFF keeps positions 31 to 0
svg.desc: Python -12 is an infinite tape: 1s at every position from 4 upward, then 0100. The mask 0xFFFFFFFF has 1s at positions 31 to 0 and 0s above. The AND keeps positions 31 to 0: 28 ones then 0100, which is 0xFFFFFFF4 = 4294967284.
